job_categories.name: Acoustics & Architectural Design
job_categories.description: Focuses on the physical behavior of sound in environments. Roles involve room tuning, noise mitigation, acoustic consulting for physical spaces, and material testing.

job_categories.name: Audio Electrical Engineering
job_categories.description: Focuses on the analog and digital circuit design of audio hardware. Roles involve PCB layout, amplifier design, and integrating electronic components for consumer and professional audio devices.

job_categories.name: Microphones & Transducer Engineering
job_categories.description: Centers on the mechanical and acoustic engineering of electroacoustic devices. Involves the physical design of loudspeakers, microphones, and headphones, focusing on mechanics, materials, magnets, and voice coils.

job_categories.name: Audio Software Engineering
job_categories.description: Involves coding core audio applications, frameworks, and middleware. Roles typically require C++, JUCE, or similar tools to build DAWs, audio engines, and processing algorithms.

job_categories.name: Music Technology
job_categories.description: A cross-disciplinary field encompassing the hardware and software design of creative musical tools. Includes the development of synthesizers, guitar pedals, MIDI controllers, and virtual instruments.

job_categories.name: Audio Systems
job_categories.description: Focuses on the end-to-end integration, measurement, and tuning of audio subsystems within complex consumer electronics, such as laptops, wearables, and smart speakers.

job_categories.name: Automotive Audio
job_categories.description: Specializes in integrating, tuning, and optimizing audio systems within vehicle cabins. Roles involve acoustic measurement, infotainment integration, and managing unique automotive acoustic constraints.

job_categories.name: Audio DSP (Digital Signal Processing)
job_categories.description: Focuses on the algorithmic manipulation of digital audio signals. Includes designing filters, EQs, dynamic range compressors, and spatial audio processing algorithms.

job_categories.name: Audio AI & Machine Learning
job_categories.description: Applies deep learning and neural networks to audio tasks. Includes roles working on audio source separation, music information retrieval (MIR), speech recognition, and generative audio models.

job_categories.name: Music Production & Recording Arts
job_categories.description: Covers the creative and technical processes of capturing and finalizing music. Includes studio tracking, mixing, mastering, and beat production.

job_categories.name: Live Sound & Event Production
job_categories.description: Centers on real-time audio deployment for concerts, theater, and corporate events. Roles include Front of House (FOH) engineering, monitor mixing, and A/V rigging.

job_categories.name: NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness)
job_categories.description: An engineering discipline focused on measuring and minimizing unwanted mechanical noise and vibration, highly prevalent in the automotive, aerospace, and industrial manufacturing sectors.

job_categories.name: Psychoacoustics & Audio Perception
job_categories.description: The scientific study of sound perception and human audiology. Roles often involve designing and conducting critical listening tests, subjective audio evaluation, and head-related transfer function (HRTF) research.

job_categories.name: Game Audio & Interactive Sound
job_categories.description: Focuses on creating and implementing non-linear sound for video games and XR environments. Requires proficiency in sound design and interactive middleware like Wwise or FMOD.
